svg.text: West branch · revised: spike entry, perimeter mirrors and protected torches · 48 × 40 tiles
PROPOSED LAYOUT • Top-down • 32px logical tiles • Plan only — not implemented
Spikes cross the EAST perimeter entrance.
Only boosted Sieg can clear the timed gap.
Coco cannot enter or fly over the trap.
A solid wall seals the southern perimeter.
Coco enters water via a separate culvert.
Sieg pushes a mirror into reflecting angle.
Coco flies to A1–A4 and fires at that mirror.
The shot reflects into its protected torch.
Sieg resets the mirror to its resting angle,
reopening his lane to reach the next station.
Gold = angled leaf; pale dashed = rest.
T1–T4 sit behind solid perimeter walls.
Narrow spell ports block player passage.
Only a paired mirror-reflected shot ignites.
Fourth torch raises ENTIRE center + bridge.
Before then: water only; no center landing.
Sieg enters through spikes on the EAST perimeter. The SOUTH perimeter is walled off; Coco uses pond pads.
Work clockwise: angle M1 → light T1 → reset M1, then repeat at M2, M3 and M4 with new shot directions.
Fourth torch raises the center platform, its chest and connecting bridge together; mirror resets clear Sieg’s lane.
Retry: lit torches latch. Spike failure returns Sieg to the east dock. No southern entrance or return shortcut.
Gold: Sieg / physical • Purple: Coco / magic • Cyan: mechanism / return • Dashed: link or conditional access
